instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lucide-react (if not installed), react-icons, @heroicons/react, react-countup.

Import Outfit and Manrope fonts from Google Fonts in index.css: `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600&family=Outfit:wght@500;600;700;800&display=swap');` and configure in tailwind.config.js.
Build a single-page marketing site structure with distinct section components in src/components/
Create a sticky navigation bar that changes state on scroll (adds glassmorphism, compacts padding). Use uploaded NexBuild logo.
For the Hero Section: Include floating/animated Framer Motion cards (e.g. 'Web Development', 'AI Solutions') around the main mockup image.
Implement an animated stat counter in the Trust Strip (e.g. using react-countup or framer-motion useInView + useEffect).
Services & Solutions Grid: Use raw Tailwind HTML, focus on generous whitespace and smooth hover interaction (icon scale up, subtle background tint).
Portfolio: Add a simple state-based filter for the tabs (All | Websites | Apps | AI | Branding) with Framer Motion AnimatePresence.
Process Timeline: Use a vertical dashed line with numbered nodes, highlight active node on scroll using Framer Motion.
Contact Form: Implement basic validation and show a success state/toast upon submission. Use Shadcn/UI Form primitives if convenient, or pure HTML+Tailwind.
Use light, clean, premium palette. Avoid overly dark sections. Use #1D6FF2 style blue as primary accent.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="contact-submit-btn"`).
DO NOT use a fully transparent header over any content that scrolls. Use backdrop-blur-xl and a semi-transparent white background (bg-white/80).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is forbidden).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or soft-rounded with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use Lucide, HeroIcons, or Phosphor icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap. Avoid overcrowding.
Include subtle grain textures or noise if suitable, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations.
All text over images/gradients must pass APCA/WCAG contrast checks.
For interactive logic, use Shadcn. For marketing layouts, use pure HTML + Tailwind to avoid rigid constraints.
Do not use generic gray backgrounds for the 'Premium' vibe - tint any gray with a hint of blue (e.g. slate-50).
